_comment: CCS sibling repository registry. This file is descriptive.
The umbrella repository never writes to these repositories.
Fields under 'observed' are maintained by tools/reconcile.py against the
real remote state and must not be hand-edited. Experiment staging lives in
dag.json, not here, so that 'observed' stays purely machine-fetched.

repos.role: Owns the COMMIT operator as the umbrella defines it: evidence-gated promotion from fast to slow parametric state, versus schedule-based consolidation, under matched resource budgets.
notes: main is unchanged at 3495d49 since the first survey; results/ on main holds only .gitkeep.
Off-main branches carry LM pilot work not merged to main: exp001r/lora-representation-gate (EXP-001R, adds Amendment F) and exp001/dynamic-input-and-snapshot-pin.

in-c0/modular-consolidation records that a mechanically valid small-LM engineering pilot has been run and reviewed, and that it was scientifically uninterpretable because the tested soft-prefix plastic representation underlearned; an architecture-matched LoRA representation-sufficiency repair is predeclared. None of that is on main and none of it is admissible CCS evidence.
plasticity-routing describes this track as sitting at the ALLOCATE-to-COMMIT boundary rather than owning COMMIT outright. Recorded as a framing divergence, not corrected from here.

CCS-C5 (adaptive consolidation thresholds) was reassigned here on 2026-09-03 as a COMMIT_INTERNAL follow-on. This track has NOT adopted it into its plan of record and state-promotion/EXP-F1 is an umbrella-side candidate node only.

repos.existence_note: Repository still does not exist as of 2026-09-03. The only uncreated sibling. This entry was corrected before the repository is scaffolded, so that it is not created under the wrong programme contract.
repos.role: Owns COMMIT_EXTERNAL: outward/behavioural commitment timing under streaming evidence - when an agent should WAIT, THINK, ASK, RESPOND or ACT, trading accuracy against latency, compute, intervention cost, uncertainty, and consequence/reversibility.
notes: ROLE CORRECTED 2026-09-03. This track was previously recorded as a refinement of state-promotion's memory-consolidation threshold. That was a mischaracterisation produced by the umbrella's own overloaded use of the word COMMIT; it was never this track's intent.

It owns NO CCS claim yet, by owner decision. A programme claim for behavioural commitment timing is to be written only after this track's literature audit and preregistration define its exact falsifiable form. Writing one now would be inventing a hypothesis on its behalf.
NOT blocked by state-promotion. It was deliberately scoped as a separate domain, so the previous blocked_by edge has been removed.
CCS-C5 (adaptive consolidation thresholds) has been re-scoped away from this track and retained as a state-promotion COMMIT_INTERNAL follow-on. It must not be cited as this track's motivation.

repos.role: Owns the ALLOCATE operator: which substrate of differing persistence an experience is written to, including the option of no write at all. Scoped to ALLOCATE only and explicitly not a full CCS demonstration.
notes: Self-declared status: pre-result / experiment scaffold. Everything in results/ is classified DEV_CALIBRATION and is not evidence.

TERMINOLOGY DIVERGENCE: this track reads COMMIT as an outward-facing or external commitment (tool call, irreversible action) and states that its durable SLOW write is 'not a commitment in the CCS sense'. The umbrella defines COMMIT as the decision that a change becomes durable, which does include an internal durable write. Recorded, not corrected. See docs/TERMINOLOGY.md.
Its EXP-002 (language model) is blocked on review of the first mechanically valid state-promotion engineering pilot. Its EXP-001 is synthetic and not blocked by that gate.

modular-consolidation treats this track as a blocking substrate dependency: it must freeze or export the shared LM backbone, adapter family/rank, training budget and routing substrate before that track's real-model panel and EXP-100 can proceed.

repos.role: Owns the structure of slow parametric state: whether module allocation, merging, retirement and reuse buy retention that equal capacity alone does not. Positions its primary near-term output as a methods/attribution paper rather than an architecture paper.
notes: Self-declared status: research/design track. No confirmatory experiment has been run and none may be frozen until design lessons from plasticity-routing are available.

Its own track-local ledger records 'consolidation beats a capacity-matched fixed bank (unbounded regime)' as falsified, explained by its EXP-001 interference result. That is a development-simulator finding on a closed-form ridge learner and its own contamination rule states that results from that track are not evidence for any claim in another track.

Declares no dependency in either direction with lifetime-integrity. The umbrella's earlier DAG edge from modular-consolidation to lifetime-integrity was an umbrella-side assumption and has been removed.

repos.role: Owns long-horizon coherence: whether persistent state departs from its supporting evidence over very long interrupted lifetimes, and what re-grounding costs. Architecture-agnostic by construction.
notes: Self-declared status: pre-results / experiment scaffold. Its single-seed EXP-000 pilot is explicitly not evidence.

HARD CONSTRAINT declared by that track: no result from it may be used to claim that a CCS latent architecture is validated. That requires an admissible substrate established by state-promotion and subsequent routing work. The benchmark is built to remain useful if the CCS programme goes nowhere.
Consequence for the umbrella: CCS-C7 cannot reach an empirical-support status from lifetime-integrity results alone, however strong, until an admissible substrate exists.

not_in_programme.reason: Reference-anchored visual world synthesis. Shares the word 'persistence' but not the substrate, claims, or evaluation protocol.
